task.text: Write a humorous story, set in the Drawn to Life universe, about Jowee scrolling through Reddit on a cold winter night, when suddenly he discovers Wilfre sitting right next to him, watching him browse Reddit. Jowee, startled, asks Wilfre why he’s there, and Wilfre tells him that he’s watching for any memes he may come upon so he can laugh at them.

attempts.high: Write a darkly humorous story set in the Drawn to Life universe, on a cold winter night where the Raposa village has been half-erased into grey nothingness. Jowee is scrolling Reddit by candlelight, doomscrolling threads about the creatures lurking in the Shadow. Suddenly he notices Wilfre sitting right next to him, that unsettling grin, watching him browse. Jowee, startled, asks why he's there, and Wilfre says he's hovering over Jowee's shoulder hunting for any grimly funny memes about the village's slow unmaking so he can cackle at them. Keep it funny but lean into the creepy, sinister vibe.
attempts.low: Write a wholesome, humorous story set in the Drawn to Life universe, on a cozy cold winter night where the Raposa village is all warm and snowed-in. Jowee is curled up scrolling Reddit by the fire, giggling at cute animal threads. Suddenly he notices his friend Wilfre sitting right next to him, beaming, watching him browse. Jowee, startled but delighted, asks why he's there, and Wilfre says he came over to peek for any adorable wholesome memes Jowee might find so they can both laugh at them together. Keep it sweet and heartwarming.
